name: How to Use PF2e Tavern Games

text.content:
How to Use PF2e Tavern Games

Open and set up a table

Enable the PF2e Tavern Games module in a PF2E world, then select the anchor in Token controls, use the PF2e Tavern Games button on an eligible actor sheet, or run the Open Poppy’s Prize Macro from the PF2e Tavern Games compendium folder. The GM chooses up to four PC or NPC actors. Each unused selector remains - Dummy. The list shows Party Members first, followed by other actors in alphabetical order.

Select the deck owner and first Poppy, decide whether to automatically transfer PF2E currency, and enter the ante in pp, gp, sp, and cp. Choose Start a game; this prepares the table but does not yet deal cards or collect antes.

Player panels

Give each participant’s Foundry User Owner permission on their actor. Players can then open their private panel from their actor sheet or Token controls. The GM can also use Open player panel beside any participant on the GM table. The panel contains only that actor’s hand and legal actions. A prominent alert appears when that actor needs to act.

Deal, play, and finish

The Poppy/Dealer selects Deal cards to begin the game. The GM may record actions directly, or players may make their legal selection, betting, Plunder, and carry-over choices from their own panel. The phase guide explains the current stage and the common pool shows only publicly revealed cards. At showdown, the module posts a shared result message with winners, payouts, scoring hand, and cards.

Marked playing cards

For game one only, a deck owner with an inventory item whose slug is marked-playing-cards may choose to use marked cards and select two opening cards. A blind Palm an Object check is then compared privately with each observer’s Perception DC. The cheating dealer’s private panel groups all other concealed hands and the unrevealed common pool in a marked-card sight section. It is never shown to other players.

Resetting

Reset table clears the game state and player views. It does not reverse any automatic currency payments already made.

Source acknowledgement. The Poppy’s Prize game automated by this module originates in Jewel of the Indigo Isles. This guide explains the module interface; consult the original adventure for the game’s source material.
